name: Piano house
notes: Nineties piano house: offbeat grand piano stabs, an organ bass and a ride, all ducked by the kick.
code:
setcpm(124/4)

drums: s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.65).duckorbit(2).duckattack(0.14).duckdepth(0.55)
claps: s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.55).room(0.3)
hats: s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.35)
ride: s("rd*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.12).pan(0.4)
piano: chord("<Bbm9 Bbm9 Gb^9 Ab9sus>").voicing().struct("[~ x] [~ x] [~ x@3] [x ~]").s("piano").gain(0.7).velocity(perlin.range(0.65, 0.95)).room(0.4).roomsize(3).orbit(2)
bass: note("<[bb1 ~ bb1 ~]*2 [bb1 ~ bb1 ~]*2 [gb1 ~ gb1 ~]*2 [ab1 ~ ab1 ab2]*2>").s("gm_drawbar_organ").clip(0.8).gain(1.3).lpf(900).orbit(2)
